description: This file defines the 'Context' class and related types for managing browser contexts, tabs, routes, and video recordings within the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for creating, disposing, and managing browser pages, handling routes, and controlling video recording, as well as configuration options and security checks.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Manages a Playwright browser context, including tabs, routes, video recordings, and configuration.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of all resources, including tabs and video recordings.

methods.name: tabs
methods.description: Returns the list of current tabs.

methods.name: currentTab
methods.description: Returns the current active tab.

methods.name: currentTabOrDie
methods.description: Returns the current tab or throws an error if none is available.

methods.name: newTab
methods.description: Creates and returns a new tab.

methods.name: selectTab
methods.description: Selects a tab by index and brings it to front.

methods.name: ensureTab
methods.description: Ensures a tab exists, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: closeTab
methods.description: Closes a specified tab and returns its URL.

methods.name: workspaceFile
methods.description: Resolves a workspace file path.

methods.name: outputFile
methods.description: Generates an output file path based on a template.

methods.name: startVideoRecording
methods.description: Starts recording video for the context.

methods.name: stopVideoRecording
methods.description: Stops video recording and returns recorded videos.

methods.name: _startPageVideo
methods.description: Starts video recording for a specific page.

methods.name: _onPageCreated
methods.description: Handles new page creation events.

methods.name: _onPageClosed
methods.description: Handles page closure events.

methods.name: routes
methods.description: Returns the list of route entries.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a new route to the context.

methods.name: removeRoute
methods.description: Removes routes matching a pattern.

methods.name: isRunningTool
methods.description: Checks if a tool is currently running.

methods.name: setRunningTool
methods.description: Sets the name of the currently running tool.

methods.name: _setupRequestInterception
methods.description: Configures request interception based on network settings.

methods.name: ensureBrowserContext
methods.description: Ensures the browser context is initialized.

methods.name: _initializeBrowserContext
methods.description: Initializes the browser context with scripts, tracing, and event handlers.

methods.name: checkUrlAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a URL is permitted based on configuration.

methods.name: lookupSecret
methods.description: Retrieves a secret value or code for use in scripts.
